ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extreme dominance of low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface, contrasted by high-intensity (white) focal spots and clusters at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across the entire visible fluke; high-contrast white circular clusters at the far-left and far-right lateral tips; isolated white pixel blobs located at approximately 1/3 and 2/3 width on the fluke's horizontal axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 115-degree aperture; vertex is clearly defined and centered between the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge; significant pixel-amplitude variance noted on the interior margin of the right lobe and at the terminal points of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the posterior margins of both lobes, tapering to acute, slightly recurved tips at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-intensity circular pixel clusters at the far-left and far-right tips (consistent with barnacle colonization); isolated circular white marks present at (~33%, 45%) and (~68%, 53%) relative coordinate positions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear tracks; a prominent vertical mark on the mid-left lobe and a diagonal mark on the upper mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcareous-type colonization (barnacle clusters) at both distal lobe tips causing significant local surface irregularity.
